title: Shree Devi Institute of Technology - Overview
content: Established in 2006, SDIT is a self-financing co-educational institution at Airport Road, Kenjar, Mangalore 574142, Karnataka. Affiliated to VTU Belagavi, recognized by AICTE New Delhi, NAAC accredited. Campus spans 12 acres. SDIT is part of the Shree Devi Education Trust (established 1992). CET Code: E146. PGCET codes: MBA B281, MCA C476, M.Tech T868.

title: SDIT Vision and Mission
content: Vision: To be an institution of academic excellence imparting technical and management education integrated with human values to face social and environmental challenges. Mission: Disseminate quality education with student-centric learning; engage and encourage students, faculty and staff; mentor students and support career development; empower professionals with entrepreneurial, social and ethical values.

title: Shree Devi Education Trust (R.) - Overview
content: The Shree Devi Education Trust, situated in Mangalore, Karnataka, was established in 1992 by a team of enlightened educationalists with a vision to provide quality education and prepare youth to become efficient professionals and upright citizens. The Trust manages multiple professional colleges: Shree Devi Institute of Technology (B.E., M.Tech, MBA, MCA), Shree Devi College of Pharmacy, Shree Devi College of Physiotherapy, Shree Devi College of Nursing, Shree Devi School of Nursing, Shree Devi College of Hotel Management, Shree Devi College of Fashion Design, Shree Devi College of Interior Design, Shree Devi College of Information Science, Shree Devi Institute of Social Work, Shree Devi College, and Shree Devi College of Allied Health Sciences.

title: UG Programs Offered at SDIT (B.E.)
content: SDIT offers 4-year (8-semester) B.E. degrees in: Computer Science & Engineering, Information Science & Engineering, CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Aeronautical Engineering.

title: PG Programs Offered at SDIT
content: SDIT offers M.Tech in Construction Technology, Master of Business Administration (MBA), and Master of Computer Applications (MCA). A Physics Research Centre supports Ph.D. programs. PGCET codes: MBA B281, MCA C476, M.Tech T868.

title: Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) Department
content: CSE Department established in 2006 offers a 4-year B.E. degree. Focus areas include industry-institute collaboration for sponsored research projects and state-of-the-art labs (Data Structure, OOPS, ECLD, Microprocessor, OS, Networking, Algorithms, DBMS, System Programming, Internet Programming). Aligned with 12 VTU Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12). Course Outcomes available for 2015, 2017, 2018, and 2021 schemes.

title: Information Science & Engineering (ISE) Department
content: ISE offers a 4-year bachelor's degree (8 semesters) following the VTU syllabus. Focus on Internet & Communication Technologies (ICT), data connectivity, and e-paradigms (e-business, e-commerce, e-learning, e-governance). Aligned with 12 Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12). Students participate in IT exhibitions, seminars, and conferences.

title: CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) Program
content: 4-year B.E. degree in CSE (AI & ML) addressing growing demand for AI/ML professionals. Focus areas: world-class AI/ML training, industry-institute collaboration for sponsored projects, state-of-the-art AI/ML facilities. Distinct from regular CSE with specialized AI/ML emphasis.

title: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science Program
content: 4-year B.E. degree in AI & Data Science. Focus on data analytics, AI algorithms, scalable data solutions, statistical modeling, big data handling. Emphasizes data-driven decision making versus AIML's algorithm development focus.

title: Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) Department
content: ECE offers B.E. affiliated to VTU. Focus on telecommunications, computer hardware, and embedded systems. Curriculum emphasizes analysis, systems implementation, operation, production, and maintenance of ECE applications. Aligned with 12 Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12). Course Outcomes available for 2015, 2017, 2018, 2021 schemes.

title: Mechanical Engineering Department
content: Mechanical Engineering applies physics and materials science for analysis, design, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems. Key facilities: CAED Lab (Computer-Aided Engineering Design), CAMD Lab (Manufacturing & Design), well-equipped workshops. Application areas: manufacturing plants, HVAC, transport, aircraft, robotics, medical devices. Core concepts: mechanics, kinematics, thermodynamics, materials science, structural analysis.

title: Civil Engineering Department
content: Civil Engineering addresses modern-day challenges of growing economy, population, and urbanization. Focus on scientifically designed sustainable physical spaces and infrastructure. Core competencies: scientific principles, materials science, analysis, synthesis, research, teamwork, leadership, and business skills. Aligned with 12 Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12).

title: Aeronautical Engineering Department
content: Aeronautical Engineering focuses on aircraft and aerospace vehicle design, stability and control, propulsion systems, low and high-speed aerodynamics, and advanced defense/space technologies. Career opportunities: commercial aviation, military aviation, satellites, missiles, aerospace components, R&D. Uses Project-Based Learning (PBL) approach. Aligned with 12 Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12).

title: M.Tech in Construction Technology
content: Postgraduate M.Tech program in Construction Technology. Focus on construction management, project execution, quality control, and facility maintenance. Graduates work in consultancy firms, quality testing labs, road projects, government projects (railways, military), private construction firms, or open independent consultancy. Middle East offers strong opportunities. Graduates can pursue teaching/research. Course Outcomes available for 2016, 2018, 2022 schemes.

title: Master of Business Administration (MBA) Program
content: MBA is a postgraduate program focusing on managerial aspects of accounting, finance, marketing, and management. Curriculum includes case studies and industrial visits. Program features: guest lectures by industry experts, workshops, industrial visits, national-level management fests, mentorship. Vision: To impart management education instilling human values. Mission: academic excellence with optimal placement opportunities, leaders with integrity, critical thinking and communication development, career support for corporate world. 5 POs: management knowledge (PO1), analytical thinking (PO2), value-based leadership (PO3), global business understanding (PO4), team leadership (PO5).

title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) Program
content: MCA is a 2-year full-time postgraduate program focusing on advanced knowledge in computer science, programming, and software development. Structure: interactive classes, national seminars, outbound activities, projects, internships. Career preparation for software development, IT consulting, systems analysis. PGCET Code: C476. 8 POs: foundation knowledge (PO1), problem analysis (PO2), sustainable solutions (PO3), modern tools (PO4), teamwork (PO5), project management (PO6), ethics (PO7), life-long learning (PO8). 3 PEOs: programming fundamentals (PEO1), industry-relevant technology (PEO2), ethical values and leadership (PEO3).

title: Engineering Program Outcomes (PO1-PO12)
content: All B.E. programs follow VTU 12 Program Outcomes: PO1 Engineering knowledge, PO2 Problem analysis, PO3 Design/development of solutions, PO4 (investigation, some depts), PO5 Modern tool usage, PO6 The engineer and society, PO7 Environment and sustainability, PO8 Ethics, PO9 Individual and team work, PO10 Communication, PO11 Project management and finance, PO12 Life-long learning.

title: B.E. Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: Pass in Pre-University Board or equivalent with minimum 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Relaxation: 40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates. Entrance routes: KCET, COMEDK, and PGCET. Management seats filled based on merit in qualifying examinations.

title: MBA Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: Pass in Bachelor's Degree examination of minimum 3 years duration with minimum 50% aggregate marks in all subjects including languages. Relaxation: 45% for SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates.

title: MCA Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: Pass in recognized BCA / Bachelor degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent, OR B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. preferably with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation. Candidates without Mathematics may need bridge courses as notified by VTU. Minimum 50% aggregate (45% for SC/ST/Category-I Karnataka).

title: M.Tech Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: Pass in qualifying degree/equivalent as prescribed by competent authority with minimum 50% aggregate in all years/semesters. Relaxation: 45% for SC, ST and Category-I candidates (only Karnataka). Valid GATE score candidates also eligible.

title: Documents Required for Admission at SDIT
content: Commonly required: Original SSLC, Original PUC marks card, Photocopy of Aadhaar card, Original Transfer Certificate (TC), Original Conduct Certificate, Passport-size photograph, Migration certificate (non-Karnataka students). Verify exact list with the admissions office.

title: Academic Framework at SDIT (VTU Curriculum)
content: SDIT follows the Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) curriculum under the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). The IQAC releases an annual academic calendar. Internal assessments are conducted 2-3 times per semester. Academic Advisory Board monitors course progress and CIE.

title: SHAPE Model - SDIT's Institutional Distinctiveness
content: SHAPE is SDIT's structured framework for Professional and Technical Quality Enhancement. The 5 components are: S - Soft Skills (communication, teamwork, leadership); H - Human Values/Life Skills (integrity, empathy, ethics workshops, yoga, stress management); A - Add-on Courses (Data Science, Cybersecurity, Advanced Software Development); P - Personality Development (mock interviews, leadership programs, coaching); E - Enhancing Technical Skills (hands-on projects, internships, hackathons, industry visits). Core aims: holistic development, competency building, culture of excellence.

title: SHAPE Model - 2nd Year Program
content: 2nd Year Foundation & Basics: Personality Development (10-hour program on conversation, listening, debating like 'Toggle Talk'); Soft Skills (36-hour program on goal setting, grooming, stress management, leadership); Technical Training Certificate (TTC) - Core subject training (10 weeks) for IT branches, general core training for others.

title: SHAPE Model - 3rd Year Program
content: 3rd Year Application & Refinement: Aptitude Training (Algebra, time-speed-distance, verbal reasoning, data interpretation); Communication Class (formal/informal communication, business emails, presentations); Soft Skills (conveying technical info, teamwork, critical thinking); TTC - Specialized technical training in advanced concepts.

title: SHAPE Model - 4th Year Program
content: 4th Year Job Readiness: Specialized Aptitude Classes (advanced mathematical concepts and problem-solving); Technical Training Sessions (deep dive into technical skills); Soft Skills Integration (professional interaction preparation); Assessment (Aptitude and Technical Tests to gauge job readiness).

title: Student Clubs at SDIT - Complete List
content: SDIT has 10 active student clubs: Lingua Nova (language & communication), Media Mavericks (photography, videography, media production), Coders Nexus (programming, hackathons), Sports Mania (athletics, tournaments), Cult-mosaic (cultural diversity, arts), Finance Club (markets, investment), Marketing Club (MAntra) (branding, digital marketing), HR Club (HRiday) (HR, leadership, organizational behavior), Samarpan (community service, social outreach), Eco Club (Sankalp) (sustainability, environment).

title: Lingua Nova Club - Language & Communication
content: Lingua Nova focuses on enhancing language proficiency, public speaking, negotiation, and written/verbal corporate communication skills through interactive workshops. Open to all students looking to improve communication abilities and corporate readiness. Benefits: confidence in public speaking, refined professional writing, preparation for global career opportunities.

title: Media Mavericks Club - Photography & Media
content: Media Mavericks is a hub for photography, videography, camera operation, media production, and editing software techniques. Open to aspiring media professionals, content creators, and photography/videography enthusiasts. Benefits: hands-on media tools experience, portfolio-building creative projects, exposure to industry trends.

title: Coders Nexus Club - Programming & Hackathons
content: Coders Nexus is centered around computer programming (Python, Java, C++), hackathons, software development, and coding challenges. Open to students interested in coding from beginners to advanced across any discipline. Benefits: strong computer science foundation, peer collaboration, updated skills with emerging technologies.

title: Sports Mania Club - Athletics & Sports
content: Sports Mania promotes athletic activity, competitive tournaments, and recreational matches in sports like football, volleyball, and indoor games. Open to any student interested in sports, physical fitness, or team activities. Benefits: physical health, teamwork, stress relief, sportsmanship.

title: Cult-mosaic Club - Cultural Diversity & Arts
content: Cult-mosaic celebrates cultural diversity, artistic talent, and heritage through creative performances, cultural exchange events, and showcases. Open to students passionate about performance arts, cultural expression, or cross-cultural collaboration. Benefits: cultural awareness, artistic outlet, unity across diverse backgrounds.

title: Finance Club - Markets & Investment
content: Finance Club explores financial markets, investment strategies, personal finance management, and wealth creation. Open to students interested in finance, management, investing, or economics. Benefits: practical money management, financial literacy, market analysis skills for future careers.

title: Marketing Club (MAntra) - Branding & Digital Marketing
content: MAntra covers branding, digital marketing strategies, advertising, and practical business growth tactics through competitions and real-world projects. Open to creative thinkers, aspiring entrepreneurs, students aiming for business or marketing careers. Benefits: creative strategy, practical marketing campaign experience, market awareness.

title: HR Club (HRiday) - Human Resources & Leadership
content: HRiday focuses on human resources management, leadership development, organizational behavior, and interpersonal management. Open to students seeking leadership roles, organizational management skills, or HR careers. Benefits: leadership qualities, interpersonal conflict resolution, practical HR knowledge.

title: Samarpan Club - Community Service & Social Impact
content: Samarpan drives social change, community service, social responsibility initiatives, and outreach campaigns. Open to any student wanting to participate in social impact, volunteering, and community welfare. Benefits: empathy, meaningful community impact, non-profit project management skills.

title: Eco Club (Sankalp) - Environmental Sustainability
content: Eco Club (Sankalp) is dedicated to environmental sustainability, conservation projects, ecological awareness campaigns, and green initiatives. Open to environmentally conscious students passionate about sustainability and ecology. Benefits: environmental awareness, local green initiative leadership, actionable sustainability habits.

title: Annual Events Calendar at SDIT
content: SDIT's academic year features 11 major annual events: Orientation Programme (September), Krishna Janmashtami Celebration (Aug/Sep), Blood Donation Camp (Sep/Oct), Samshodhan Technical Project Exhibition (Oct/Nov), SURABHI Intra-College Cultural & Technical Fest (Nov/Dec), Technospark State-Level Science Model Exhibition (January), Annual Sports Meet (February), Shree Devi Sambhram National Level Fest (March), Alumni Meet (April), Annual Day (May), Graduation Day & Farewell (May/June).
source: KB Expansance - Key Events and Milestones

title: Orientation Programme (September)
content: Designed to introduce new students to the college environment, academic policies, campus facilities, and faculty members, helping them transition smoothly into their degree programs. Approximate Date: September (Beginning of Academic Year).

title: Krishna Janmashtami Celebration (Aug/Sep)
content: A vibrant campus celebration featuring traditional activities, including devotional songs (bhajans), skits depicting episodes from Krishna's life, and traditional games like Dahi Handi. Approximate Date: August / September.

title: Blood Donation Camp (Sep/Oct)
content: A community service initiative organized by the college in partnership with local health organizations to promote health awareness and encourage voluntary blood donation among students and staff. Approximate Date: September / October.

title: Samshodhan - Technical Project Exhibition (Oct/Nov)
content: An intra-college project showcase where engineering and management students display innovative technical projects, models, and research prototypes to faculty and external judges. Approximate Date: October / November.

title: SURABHI - Intra-College Cultural & Technical Fest (Nov/Dec)
content: An internal talent competition featuring technical paper presentations, coding challenges, music, dance, and literary contests to select representatives for inter-collegiate events. Approximate Date: November / December.

title: Technospark - State-Level Science Model Exhibition (January)
content: A prestigious state-level platform bringing together students from various institutions to demonstrate scientific discoveries, hardware models, and technological solutions. Approximate Date: January.

title: Annual Sports Meet (February)
content: A multi-day track and field sports competition showcasing athletic talent, team sports (football, volleyball, cricket), and promoting fitness across all departments. Approximate Date: February.

title: Shree Devi Sambhram - National Level Fest (March)
content: The institution's flagship national-level fest featuring competitive technical symposia, cultural performances, and live music concerts with invited celebrity artists. Approximate Date: March.

title: Alumni Meet (April)
content: An interactive annual reunion connecting former graduates with current students and faculty to foster professional networking, career mentorship, and industry linkages. Approximate Date: April.

title: Annual Day (May)
content: A grand end-of-year event celebrating academic achievements, prize distributions for intra-college competitions, and artistic showcases by student groups. Approximate Date: May.

title: Graduation Day & Farewell Day (May/June)
content: Formal ceremonies marking the academic culmination for graduating batches, featuring degree conferral addresses, award presentations, and farewell celebrations. Approximate Date: May / June.

title: Placement Process & Infrastructure
content: Placement starts in the 7th semester for final-year students. Process includes on-campus drives and pool campus interviews (region-wide involving other engineering colleges in Mangalore region). Facilities: seminar halls for company presentations, Group Discussion (GD) rooms, conferencing facilities, dedicated interview and discussion rooms. Departmental objectives: develop balanced technical/interpersonal skills, forge technology alliances between institution and industries, provide quality technical manpower.

title: Placement Training Department & Programs
content: Department of Placement & Training is the nodal agency for career counseling, higher education guidance, and industry connections. Programs: Pre-Placement Training (aptitude, logical skills, interviews for final year), Aptitude & Technical Training (2nd & 3rd year), Pre-Placement Talks (industry leaders), Mock Interviews (by experts), Internship Assistance (project students), Higher Education Talks (study abroad, CAT, GMAT). Industrial Visits for 2nd, 3rd, and Final year students. Goals: single window career hub, training infrastructure for value-added programs, best practices for campus placements, computerized database of students.

title: Best Practice 1: Green Campus Initiative
content: SDIT's Green Campus initiative fosters environmental consciousness, sustainable practices, and a clean, healthy environment. Renewable Energy: 136-kW solar power system, LED lighting, solar water heaters. Water Conservation: Rainwater harvesting systems. Waste Management: Dry/Wet segregation, E-Waste collection with MOU with Moogambigai Metal Refineries (Jan 21, 2021), Vermicomposting, Sewage Treatment. Green Spaces: Botanical Garden with medicinal/herbal plants, Eco Trail, Green Blossom Fountain, Canteen Garden (Eco-Bite). Awareness: Environmental Day celebrations, sapling gifting, cleanliness drives. Achievements: Gold Ranking as 'Green College' (Green Mentors' Accreditation), Green College Audit 2022-25 compliance, reduced carbon footprint.

title: Best Practice 2: Samarpan - Social Outreach Initiative
content: Samarpan is a reformative initiative toward societal excellence that instills values of generosity, bridges the urban-rural divide, and uplifts underprivileged communities. Programs: Annual outreach to orphanages, old age homes, rural schools, charitable institutions; Fundraising via movie screenings, fairs, sales, food fests; Proceeds to Aloka Foundation (MOU Sept 17, 2021); Blood donation drives; AIDS awareness; Digital literacy for rural households; Beach cleaning (with Vana Charitable Trust); Tree plantation; Cultural programs for differently-abled; Visits to Anirveda (special children school) and White Doves Psychiatric Home. Partnerships with St. Anthony's Ashram, Samvedhana Home, Snehadeep Orphanage.

The SHAPE program focuses on Soft Skills, Human Values, Add-on courses, Personality Development, and Enhancing Technical Skills.
